title: AnyBlock JSON property dictionary
description: One properties.json at the root of a bundle names every property the bundle's objects use. A sibling of index.json: an index says where things are, a dictionary says what they mean. Every entry carries its own format and states the complete definition, bundled key or not, so a reader can interpret a backup without shipping the bundled table.

$schema.description: Which of the format's three grammars this document follows. Optional, since `formatVersion` gates the version, but a reader dispatches on it and a URL naming another grammar is refused.

properties.description: One property definition per property the bundle's objects reference. Each entry's `property` holds the canonical spelling: the bundled table's display name for a bundled key, the stored key otherwise.

dictionaryEntry.description: A property definition plus `hidden`, `api_key`, `bundled_diverged`, `value_names` and `uninstalled`; `format` required. Identify with `property`, `internal_key` or, off an `unknown` entry, `name`.

allOf.description: Which shape this entry has: a property definition, unless `format` is the sentinel `unknown`, in which case the entry states identity only and nothing else.

name.description: When `name` supplies the property identity, it is NFC-normalized before the 128-character key bound applies. This schema checks the non-empty, control-free part; readers enforce the bound.

object_types.description: objects and files only: the types the property may point at, in priority order, each as the derived id `type-<internal_key>`. A display name or the legacy `ot-<key>` is accepted on input.

value_names.description: The complete, sorted set of names a value of this property can take. Written where `format` is `number` and the number means an app enum: a value is the name, never the number. Export writes it.

uninstalled.description: The user removed this property from the space; a reader must not present it as in use. Export writes `true` only, never an author. A type's `property_definitions` entry states it too.

api_key.description: The property's public API key, the spelling callers address it by. Not a slug of the name: it does not follow a rename. Export writes it where the store holds one; an author never writes one.

hidden.description: The store hides this property from every listing. Export writes `true` only; absent means the same as `false`. An author never writes it.

bundled_diverged.description: The space's copy of a bundled property failed the identity check against the bundled table, so a reader takes this entry over its own. Export writes `true` only, never an author.

undefinedPropertyEntry.description: An entry for a property key the bundle's documents reference and nothing could define. Export writes it, never an author. It states identity only, and a reader must not create a property from it.

property.description: The entry's spelling. For a key nothing defines this is the stored key verbatim, since a key the bundled table does not name has no other spelling.

internal_key.description: The stored key itself, the key the documents' values are written under.

format.description: The sentinel: no definition of this property could be found. Not a format; see this shape's description.
